en: BILL: Hey, there!\nCELIO!
CELIO: BILL!\nI can't believe you came out here.
BILL: Well, absolutely!\nHow's your research coming along?\p…Oh, wait a sec.
{PLAYER}, this is my buddy CELIO.\nHe's one dedicated PC MANIAC!
CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, a rising\ncontender as the POKéMON CHAMP!
CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, the\nreigning POKéMON CHAMP!
CELIO: That's really impressive.\pI hate to say it, but I have zero\naptitude for battling.\pAnyways, I'm glad to meet you.
BILL: So, bring me up to speed.\nHow's your machine running?
CELIO: It's running fine, but we're\ntoo remote out here.\pThe PCs on this island just can't\nlink with your PC, BILL.
BILL: Oh, yeah?\nOkay, let me take a look-see.\p…Hang on here…\nI think we can make it work.\lLet me help you, okay?

{PLAYER}, can I get you to wait for
me just a bit?\p…Actually, can I get you to do
me a favor?\pThe island next to this one's
called TWO ISLAND.\pThere's a guy there that runs
a GAME CORNER.\pHe has this thing for rare rocks
and gems.\pWe keep in touch, being fellow
maniacs.\pSo, can I get you to deliver this
METEORITE to him?
{PLAYER} accepted the METEORITE\nfrom BILL.
CELIO: {PLAYER}, if you are going\nto TWO ISLAND, please take this.
It's a PASS for the ferry service\nserving the local islands.\pIt will let you travel between the\nISLANDS ONE, TWO, and THREE.\pOh, you should have this, too.
{PLAYER} received an extra page\nfor the TOWN MAP!
{PLAYER} received\na TOWN MAP!
BILL: I'll catch you later!\nSay hi to the guy for me!
Hmm…\pHow about we try this like this…

Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pDid you see?
We got the PC working!\pI've got a few things to show
CELIO here.\pCan you go out on a stroll or
something for a while more?
I'm sorry for taking up so much of\nBILL's time.\pI'm also sorry for being such a \npoor host on your visit here.
The usual PC services aren't\navailable…
BILL: Oh, hey!\n{PLAYER}!
BILL: What kept you so long?\nBeen out having a good time?\pWe got it done.\nThe PCs are up and running!
CELIO: The job went incredibly\nquick.\pBILL is one amazing guy…
BILL: No, no! There was almost\nnothing left for me to do.\pCELIO, I have to hand it to you.\nYou've learned a lot.
CELIO: Oh, really?\nEhehe…
BILL: Well, there you have it.\nI'm finished with the job.\lWe should head back to KANTO.\pCELIO, I'll be seeing you again.
CELIO: {PLAYER}, I'm really sorry\nthat we sent you off alone today.\pI promise, I will show you around\nthese islands sometime.

CELIO: Hello!
You look awfully busy as always.\pHow am I doing?\pWell, I'm modifying my Network
Machine.\pWhen I get done with the machine,
I hope you'll be first to use it,\l{PLAYER}.

CELIO: {PLAYER}, how have things
been for you?\pOh, is that right?
You've caught more POKéMON.\pDo you know what?
Maybe I can be useful to you.

I'm modifying the Network Machine
right now.\pI'm changing it so it can handle
trades over long distances.\pWhen I get finished, you'll be
trading for exotic POKéMON from\lTRAINERS far away.
But, there is a slight catch.\pFor the link to work, the Machine\nneeds a special gemstone.\pIt's supposed to be on ONE ISLAND,\nbut I haven't found one yet.\pWho knows where it could be.

I was trying to find the gem
even while I was studying.\pAs a result, I've made no headway
in both my search and studies…\pIf I relied on BILL, I'm sure my
research would progress.\pBut this time, I want to try to do
things by myself.
Oh!\nTh-that's…
{PLAYER} handed the RUBY\nto CELIO.
Thank you!\n{PLAYER}, you're simply amazing.\p… … …  … … …\pUm… May I ask one more giant favor\nof you?
It… It's not anything weird.\nPlease, I need your help.

While I was studying gemstones,
I discovered something important.\pThere is another gem that forms
a pair with this RUBY.\pThat other gemstone is supposed to
be in the SEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I need you to go
find the other gem.\p{PLAYER}, may I have your ferry
PASS and the TOWN MAP?
{PLAYER} returned the TRI-PASS and\nreceived the RAINBOW PASS.
Obtained an extra page for the\nTOWN MAP!
This is my own ferry PASS.\pIt will let you get to all the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I can't do\nit without your help.
{PLAYER} handed the SAPPHIRE\nto CELIO.

CELIO: So this is the gem that
forms a pair with the RUBY…\p{PLAYER}, you've gone through a lot
to get this, didn't you?\pYou don't have to tell me. I know
it wasn't easy.\pThank you so much!\pNow it's my turn to work for you!
Please give me a little time.
Okay, this is good…
I did it!\nI linked up with LANETTE!

{PLAYER}…
{PLAYER}, I did it!\pI've managed to link up with
TRAINERS in the HOENN region!\pFinally, the Network Machine is
fully operational!\p{PLAYER}, I owe it all to you!\pThanks to you, my dream came
true…
I…\nI'm not crying.\pThat's enough about me!\p{PLAYER}, you're going to keep\nlooking for exotic POKéMON, right?\pI wish you the best of luck!
CELIO: Hello!\p{PLAYER}, I've been hearing rumors\nabout you.

{PLAYER}, what's your favorite kind
of POKéMON?\pBILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves
every kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught
was an ABRA.

By the way, {PLAYER}, you're from
PALLET TOWN, aren't you?\pI've heard that it's a quiet and
pleasant place.\pBILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,
where his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the
festive, bustling city.\pI'd like to go there one day.
{PLAYER}, is there anything that\nyou can't stand?\pApparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.
Oh, you're a stranger here!\nHi! Where did you come from?\p…PALLET TOWN?\nI don't know it!
On this island, there's an enormous\nvolcano.\pIt hasn't erupted lately, so why\nnot enjoy a hike?
I wish I could trade POKéMON with\nmy boyfriend who lives far away…
I traded POKéMON with my boyfriend\nfar away!\pEveryone's saying that we can\nthank you and CELIO.\pSo, thank you!
Network Machine\nLink Level 0\p…POKéMON Storage System under\nadjustment…
Network Machine\nLink Level 1\pLink established with the KANTO\nregion.
Network Machine\nLink Level 2\pLink established with the KANTO\nand HOENN regions.
Obtained the TRI-PASS!
